title: ID0445636-DC/Si-D/IL- [MP / PN 170001155] DC2 in error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
On charger PN 170001155], the DC2 connector has been out of service and marked
Out of Order/Faulted since 24 Aug 2025 around 13:19 (Israel time).
We would appreciate your guidance on how to resolve this issue and whether a
firmware update or component replacement is required.
Solution: Either modbus cables or faulty BC2
Notes: there is no error present in the charger at the moment (27/08)

additional_info.subject: ID0445636-DC/Si-D/IL- [MP / PN 170001155] DC2 connector out of order CRM:02832000370
additional_info.body:
Hi Ziv, good morning. I hope you are doing well today.
I apologise for the delay as we faced a surge in tickets.
I checked the logs and found that there is a communication problem with the Isolation Meter Device. This is the reason why the DC2 is not working 100% of the times.
@Orel, I will send the troubleshooting steps to you directly for troubleshooting.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
